svg.aria-label: C4 level 3, components of the data plane: connectors write the extract.duckdb contract, the SyncOrchestrator ATTACHes each source and rebuilds master views into either the legacy or the DuckLake backend, and the API serves queries, the manifest and downloads; scheduler and worker jobs drive it, and a distribution mirror plus signed URLs carry a parquet to agnes pull on a laptop.
